How to get a safe token
Do NOT use a classic (ghp_…) token that manages your whole account. Create a fine-grained token: it reaches only the repositories you pick, with only the permissions needed, and it expires.
1. Open GitHub\'s token page with the button below. Name, expiry (90 days) and permissions come pre-filled.

2. Repository access: choose \"Only select repositories\" and tick only the repos Kripton will work on (this cannot be pre-filled). If the repo belongs to an organization, pick it as Resource owner; admin approval may be needed.
3. Press \"Generate token\" and copy the github_pat_… value. GitHub shows it only once.
4. Paste it into the field below and save.
• Contents: Read and write — to download the repo as a zip and commit files
• Actions: Read-only — to read CI results and error logs
• Metadata: Read-only — GitHub adds this automatically
Optional: Workflows: Read and write. Only if you want the AI to change .github/workflows files too; otherwise leave it off.
Do not grant: Administration, Secrets, Pull requests, Account permissions or \"All repositories\".
This is a classic token: it cannot be limited to chosen repos and can reach every repo on your account. I recommend switching to a fine-grained token.
